_comment: Portland ME — GENERATION C workbook (Import Candidates tab; the only metro on this generation). NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check. NOTE the workbook's own rows span Cumberland, Sagadahoc and York counties and reach as far south as Kittery/York — the observed bbox will be large, and whether the southern York County rows belong to the Portland-South Portland MSA or the Portsmouth NH-ME MSA is an owner call to settle when the envelope is locked.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Portland-South Portland, ME MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Cumberland, York, Sagadahoc), York (Maine), Sagadahoc (Maine)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 41 geocoded venue(s) of 41 in this batch (observed lat 43.0973..43.9373, lng -70.7874..-69.8328). York County's OSM boundary extends offshore into the Gulf of Maine, which is why latMin (42.92) sits south of the Maine coastline. The box therefore also clips Portsmouth NH; that is blocked independently by this config's "states": ["ME"] preflight assertion, which rejects any non-Maine row regardless of the envelope.
msa: Portland-South Portland, ME (Cumberland, York, Sagadahoc counties)
